notes.title: 29.01.2025 game update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/7ebc4764d7c89fc4f666047b4fb619eee9654cbf.png[/img]

The following changes were made to the game during maintenance today:

🔹The "Great Concern" event has started.

🔹The construction of siege weapons has been reworked:
▪ The defense decree that slows down the construction of siege weapons no longer applies to allies (clans that are part of the same alliance) of the castle defenders.
▪ Defenders can now build siege weapons both inside and outside the castle, including near its walls, even if the gates are not broken.
▪ Allies of defenders are now allowed to build siege weapons inside and under the castle walls, just like the defenders themselves.
▪ Allies of defenders and defenders are prohibited from building rams, automatic catapults, and airships.
▪ Added a ban on applying positive effects (buffs) to siege weapons.

🔹Fixed the inability to talk to the castle castellan when not in an alliance.
🔹Castle defenders now receive a standard "Sphere of Protection" for 20 seconds when reviving inside the castle.

🔹The war between alliances has been reworked. The following rules now apply:
▪ During a war between alliances, it is prohibited to leave or kick out clan members, as well as disband the clan.
▪ To declare war on another alliance, all clans in your alliance must have positive influence.
▪ You can declare war on another alliance even if the clans in it have negative influence.
▪ After the war, the winning alliance will receive the prize influence only from those losing clans that had non-negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing clans will lose 4500 influence points in any case, even if they already had negative influence at the end of the war.
▪ The losing alliance gets a 5-day grace period until the next war.

🔹Fixed the unnecessary write-off of the royal tax for entering the dungeon when there are no more attempts to enter.
🔹Increased the running speed of the Mummy, Tamed Shieldback and Beast.

🔹Eliminated the write-off of the energy resource (or mana) from the character in case of unsuccessful use of the following abilities:
▪ "Comet", "Hail of Blows" of the monk;
▪ "Teleport" of the sorcerer;
▪ "Furious Leap", "Berserker Leap" of the barbarian;
▪ "Step into the Shadow" of the assassin.
🔹The mechanism for writing off the energy resource (or mana) when using the following continuous abilities has been reworked: "Rain of Arrows", "Burst", "Discharge", "Fire Rain", "Power Giving".
Now the resource is spent gradually in portions, and not entirely, as it was before. However, to start using the abilities, you still need to have the amount of resource specified in them.
🔹Changes in ability costs:
▪ Pathfinder:
- Arrow Rain – cost increased from 45 to 65.
- Burst – cost increased from 60 to 65. Simplify 2 now reduces cost by 5, instead of 10.
▪ Sorcerer
- Discharge – ability cost increased from 9 to 12.
- Fire Rain – ability cost increased from 40 to 45.
▪ Priest
- Empower – ability cost increased from 15 to 17
▪ Necromancer
- Blood Stream – ability cost increased from 12 to 15.
🔹Ability upgrade points have been reset for the following classes: Necromancer, Priest, Pathfinder, Sorcerer.

Have a nice game!

◽️ Royal decrees that change the conditions of the game in an entire location.
◽️ Throne room with a storage for 20 million gold.

◽️ Necromancer monsters now pose a serious threat.
◽️ Assassins deal both magical and physical damage.
◽️ Sorcerers have received mass sleep - be careful!

🔹The new server "Theia" is waiting for you!🔹
Global update - it's time to plunge into a fresh game world and start your journey with a clean slate:
◽️ Recapture legendary castles from monsters and collect royal armor.
◽️ Claim your original nickname — without unnecessary "xxx" around the edges.
◽️ Be the first to get rare items that no one else on the server has.
◽️ Be one of the first to reach level 60 and get a special prize!

The New Year is rushing towards us, and it cannot be ignored! New Year's events have already appeared in the world of the Sphere. Long live the battles with snowballs and icicles, communication with snowmen and, of course, gifts, gifts, gifts!

🔹Event "The Feast of the Snow Whirl"🔹
◽️ Collect snowflakes, combine snowmen and get valuable rewards:
◽️ "Gift of the Whirlwind" effect — up to +40% to experience, gold, production and regeneration.

◽️ Lots of useful prizes and guaranteed main rewards after a certain number of attempts.

🔹Snow Fairytale Season🔹
◽️ The New Year's atmosphere has engulfed the Sphere! Put on a hat, hand out gifts, and ride the legendary sleigh of Sinek Klamus.
◽️ A new pet - the magical bear Kili and a new loot collector - the snowman Lopa.
◽️ A chance to get Klamus' bag of gifts and his headdress. Ho-ho-ho!
◽️ More than a hundred different prizes for everyone!
◽️ A new season of all arenas and dungeons is a great time to write your name in history.

notes.title: Full update of the castle mechanics!
notes.notes:
Friends!
 
Castle sieges have existed unchanged for a long time, and the time has come for pleasant changes! There has been a real revolution in the rules you know. Read more about the new sieges and castle rewards below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/d6c2647374f86af26265b6238964d67b11acdb60.png[/img]

[h2]Changes in siege mechanics[/h2]

All castles in sieges now correspond to level 60. What does it mean? If previously the level of a player in a siege was reduced to the level of a castle, now the levels of all participants in the siege are equal to the 60th.
 
However, this does not make all castles the same - their value and power will, as before, vary from the weakest Almaerta and Bansolas to the richest and most powerful Shiai Tok. In the clans window, you can see the gradation of castles from level 60 to 100.

Let's look at some aspects of this change.

[list]
[*] The effect of the castle territory, which lowers the character's level to the level of the castle upon entering the castle territory, has been removed.
[*] Upon entering the castle territory, high-level effects and skills charging are no longer removed.
[*] At the end of the siege, PvP mode is removed from everyone and all negative buffs are removed (previously all were removed).
[*] All external merchants selling castle consumables now sell a common trade set consisting of level 60 weapons and consumables.
[*] The price of some castle goods has also been raised, for example, castle brewing elixirs.
[*] Only level 60 castle guns remained for sale.
[*] The damage of castle boilers with a burning mixture and catapults has been increased.
[*] Gates of all castles, castle monsters, castle defenders (summoned bosses for castle tokens) are now level 60.
[*] The castle carpenter remained unchanged - it restores 30% of the gate's HP at a time.
[*] Helper guards summoned with the help of a clan skill have been strengthened.
[/list]

[h2]Updated castle treasures[/h2]

The potions in the chest were replaced with potion boxes, new potions in the boxes were added (for energy, fanaticism and rage). All of them correspond to level 60, but differ depending on the level of the castle.
Previously, castle equipment had a level according to the level of the castle, but now all of it corresponds to level 60. The level of items remaining in the hands of the players will remain the same, however, when the castle is recaptured or items are recalled, their level will change to 60.
Castle buffs have been changed - they have become weaker on low-level castles and stronger on high-level ones.

We do not plan to stop at these changes - there are even more interesting updates ahead. And of course, we want to know what you think of the updated castles. We look forward to seeing your impressions and suggestions on what improvements you would like to see in the castle siege game in the comments.

Enjoy the game and exciting sieges!

notes.title: Pet System Update
notes.notes:
Do you have a lot of pets that you don't play with? Don't do it like that, pets love attention and care! In this game update, we made it so that even those little friends whose bonuses you do not need will be useful and will be able to bring you nice and important gifts!

Introducing the Mercenary Pet System!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10936705/fca67e1988077608bfad82f0ecf44799687f89fe.png[/img]

The essence of the system is that you can collect pumped pets in small groups and send them on special tasks. Pets go on a mission in automatic mode and after some time return with prey.

Loot is a different set of items:

pet food,
all kinds of consumables
coins of the Free Baronies,
runes,
gold,
elevation tokens,
alchemical spices
paints
and much more, depending on the level and type of task.

Let's take a closer look at the system.

Three buttons appeared at the bottom of the pets window - the actual list of pets for calling, tasks and training.

Tasks
The quest window has 6 slots, the first three are unlocked at character level 10, 30, and 50, and three more after completing 50, 100, and 250 pet quests.

When you click the "Get" button, you are prompted to select pets that will go on a mission. Depending on the selected pets, you will see the chance of successful completion of the task and the chance of receiving an additional reward. The chance to receive an additional reward appears only if you have reached 100% chance of receiving the main reward. The chance of success depends on the number of eligible pets and their desired properties.

Also, sending on a mission will require you to give a certain amount in gold. Here you can also see the time the execution will take. In the next updates, the game will introduce an accelerator - an item with which you can complete the task faster.

The tasks available to you at the moment depend on the level of your character. After completing one task, a new one immediately appears in the vacated slot. Once a day, you can reset the task in one of the task slots for free.

Pet properties
The properties of pets are exactly what is responsible for the success of their tasks. This parameter does not carry other functions yet. A pet can have one primary property and one additional property.

Basic properties:

Secretive
Fast
Magical
Beast
Strong
Crusher
Additional properties:

Speed ​​- speeds up the task by 3/6/9/12/15/18%
Luck - gives a chance for an additional reward of 1/2/3/4/5/6%
Skill - additionally increases the chance of success by 1/2/4/6/8/10%
Savings - reduces the cost of sending (if any) by 1/3/5/7/9/11%
Additional properties of pets are available for pumping in the "Training" window. Leveling them will require you to exalt tokens and gold.

Any changes to the pet's properties after they are sent to a quest will not affect the outcome of the current quest.

Now there is a job for each of your pets!

notes.title: Global Update: Craft System and More!
notes.notes:
Dear Players! 

Sphere 3 is getting more and more interesting! The new opportunities appear and some known thing get new attributes.Please find below the patch notes for Global Update. 

[h1]Craft System [/h1]

The Crafting system allows players to obtain materials in the game world and to refine them into final products. The activities players may participate in while crafting are determined by the player’s chosen profession. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10936705/84c1116102aa7a21287e582f7fbf5ec60def9c77.jpg[/img]

[b]Craft professions[/b]

There are two types of professions: 
Refining professions allow you to convert basic materials (such as metal ores) found in the game world into advanced materials (such as metal ingots). 
There are several professions in this category:
[list]
[*]Metal forging
[*]Woodworking
[*]Herbalism 
[*]Currying
[*]Weaving
[*]Ore grinding 
[/list]
All of them complement various crafting professions. 
Crafting professions allow you to produce actual items (such as equipment and arcana) from advanced materials:
[list]
[*]Weapon smithing (weapons) 
[*]Artefactory (magical weapons (rods, staves, symbols) and relics) 
[*]Armor smithing (heavy armor and shields) 
[*]Leatherworking (medium armor) 
[*]Tailoring (cloth «armor» and bags) 
[*]Jewelcrafting (jewellery — amulets, bracelets and rings) 
[*]Alchemy (arcana and elixirs) 
[/list]

To obtain a crafting profession you need to learn it from a special character (an instructor) and pay some gold as a tuition fee. Refining professions are secondary and cannot be learned separately, you will get them automatically when you learn the corresponding crafting profession. For example, you will automatically learn “metal forging: and “woodworking” the moment you become a weapon smith. 
Crafting professions have experience levels similar to the character’s combat profession (his class), from 1 to 45. The level of your refining professions is always equal to the level of your crafting one. Both professions will level up as you craft more items. 
The amount of crafting experience you get depends on the level of your crafting profession and the level of a recipe being crafted. You will get less experience for crafting recipes below your profession level. 
The profession level determines which items the character will be able to produce and which sources of raw materials will be available. 
A character may learn only one crafting profession at a time. If you change your mind, you may remove the existing profession and pick a different one, but you will lose all of your progress by doing so.


[b]Materials[/b]

Gathering raw materials does not require any special skills (such as gathering professions). 
Materials can be gathered from special nodes that appear in the game world:
[list]
[*]Herbs and flowers
[*]Saplings
[*]Ore veins
[*]Monsters
[/list]
You need to have a specific tool in your inventory to gather raw materials (such as a pickaxe to mine ore or a hunting knife to skin animals) by interacting with the node (via clicking it or pressing the interaction button). Once gathering is complete, you will see a loot window similar to the one you see when you loot monsters. After you’ve picked up the recourses, the window closes automatically and the resource node disappears soon after. 
Your ability to gather resources from a node is limited by your profession level. 
By harvesting resource nodes you obtain basic materials that need to be refined before they can be used in actual crafting. This is where refining professions become handy:
[list]
[*]Metal forging allows you to smelt metal ores into ingots (for weapon and armor smithing).
[*]Woodworking allows you to process logs and cut them into bars used to craft bows, polearms, rods and staves.
[*]Herbalism allows you to grind plants and mushrooms into powders used in alchemy. 
[*]Currying allows you to tan the hides of slain monsters and receive skins, scales or fur used in leatherworking to create medium armor. 
[*]Weaving allows you to create cloth from plants that is used in tailoring to create light armor. 
[*]Ore grinding will allow you to prospect metal ores and find gems used in jewelcrafting. 
[/list]

As you can see, crafting requires advanced materials (that can be obtained by refining basic resources). 
But that’s just the beginning. The creation of some items will require special ingredients. They can only be obtained from bosses, and task will be quite challenging.


[b]Crafting recipes. Item creation. [/b]

So you’ve learned a new profession, gathered enough materials and are prepared to create valuable items? Not so fast! You’re going to need a few recipes first. 

Where do I get the recipes? 
You get your first recipe automatically as soon as you learn your new profession, as well as the basic recipes for the accompanying refining professions. This knowledge and a little bit of resources will help you to level your profession up. You can purchase recipes up to level 7 from the trainer who taught you the secrets of your trade. After that, you’ll need to go hunting or visit an auction house. 

You may get new recipes from monsters of appropriate level both in dungeons and on the surface. 

An unlearned recipe looks like a consumable item (a scroll). To learn the recipe, you need to have a sufficiently advanced matching profession. The scroll containing a recipe disappears after use, but the recipe itself will be added to the known recipes section of your crafting interface.

[b]Item creation[/b]

Let’s take a closer look at the crafting process.

To open the crafting interface, make sure you’ve learned a profession from a matching instructor and press К or click an icon in the bottom menu.

Alternatively, you may approach a crafting station for your profession and press “Use”.

In craft interface window you may see all of the recipes you have already learned, the item you are about to create, equipment the materials you’re going to need, the amount of gold you are going to spend on crafting the item (or several items), the number of items you wish to create. 

Here you go, we wish you lucky craft! 

[h1]Unique item properties[/h1]

The battles in the world of Ericuria are about to become even more exciting! From now on all equipment in the world of Sphere comes with special properties. Now you’ll be able to become a proud owner of truly unique and wondrous things that nobody else has. 

When an item appears in the world, there is a small chance it comes with a number of special properties we call [b]affixes[/b]. 

Affixes can be very different: some may increase or decrease the item’s attributes, others may give it unusual properties or increase the number of gemstone sockets. 

You may get such an item by crafting it or by looting it from a threatening monster. Your best chance to receive such a special reward is to craft an item using a recipe obtained from a boss monster. Traditional crafting recipes yield items with affixes less often, and only the luckiest of players will get such treasures from enemies. 

You may get items with affixes by crafting traditional recipes above level 30 or by crafting recipes obtained from boss monsters above level 10. 

[h1]Enhancement system changes[/h1]

From now on upgrading an item without a protection crystal may result in critical failure. In this case the item loses its current enhancement level and may become damaged. Attempting to enhance an item without protection crystals may lead to one of the following results: 
[list]
[*]the attempt succeeds and the item enhancement level increases by 1. 
[*]the attempt fails and the item enhancement level decreases. 
[*]the attempt fails and the item becomes damaged. 
[*]the attempt fails, the item becomes damaged and its enhancement level decreases.
[*]the attempt fails but nothing else happens. 
[/list]
A damaged item remains functional. You may equip it and keep using it in the future, but you won’t be able to enhance or enchant it ever again. You will not be able to socket any gemstones, either. 

[b]Please use caution and remember to use protection crystals if you wish to continue upgrading your piece of equipment in the future.[/b]

Have a great time in Sphere 3!

For example, you will automatically learn “metal forging: and “woodworking” the moment you become a weapon smith. 
Crafting professions have experience levels similar to the character’s combat profession (his class), from 1 to 45. The level of your refining professions is always equal to the level of your crafting one. Both professions will level up as you craft more items. 
The amount of crafting experience you get depends on the level of your crafting profession and the level of a recipe being crafted. You will get less experience for crafting recipes below your profession level. 
The profession level determines which items the character will be able to produce and which sources of raw materials will be available. 
A character may learn only one crafting profession at a time. If you change your mind, you may remove the existing profession and pick a different one, but you will lose all of your progress by doing so.


[b]Materials[/b]

Gathering raw materials does not require any special skills (such as gathering professions). 
Materials can be gathered from special nodes that appear in the game world:
[list]
[*]Herbs and flowers
[*]Saplings
[*]Ore veins
[*]Monsters
[/list]
You need to have a specific tool in your inventory to gather raw materials (such as a pickaxe to mine ore or a hunting knife to skin animals) by interacting with the node (via clicking it or pressing the interaction button). Once gathering is complete, you will see a loot window similar to the one you see when you loot monsters. After you’ve picked up the recourses, the window closes automatically and the resource node disappears soon after. 
Your ability to gather resources from a node is limited by your profession level. 
By harvesting resource nodes you obtain basic materials that need to be refined before they can be used in actual crafting. This is where refining professions become handy:
[list]
[*]Metal forging allows you to smelt metal ores into ingots (for weapon and armor smithing).
[*]Woodworking allows you to process logs and cut them into bars used to craft bows, polearms, rods and staves.
[*]Herbalism allows you to grind plants and mushrooms into powders used in alchemy. 
[*]Currying allows you to tan the hides of slain monsters and receive skins, scales or fur used in leatherworking to create medium armor. 
[*]Weaving allows you to create cloth from plants that is used in tailoring to create light armor. 
[*]Ore grinding will allow you to prospect metal ores and find gems used in jewelcrafting. 
[/list]

As you can see, crafting requires advanced materials (that can be obtained by refining basic resources). 
But that’s just the beginning. The creation of some items will require special ingredients. They can only be obtained from bosses, and task will be quite challenging.


[b]Crafting recipes. Item creation. [/b]

So you’ve learned a new profession, gathered enough materials and are prepared to create valuable items? Not so fast! You’re going to need a few recipes first. 

Where do I get the recipes? 
You get your first recipe automatically as soon as you learn your new profession, as well as the basic recipes for the accompanying refining professions. This knowledge and a little bit of resources will help you to level your profession up. You can purchase recipes up to level 7 from the trainer who taught you the secrets of your trade. After that, you’ll need to go hunting or visit an auction house. 

You may get new recipes from monsters of appropriate level both in dungeons and on the surface. 

An unlearned recipe looks like a consumable item (a scroll). To learn the recipe, you need to have a sufficiently advanced matching profession. The scroll containing a recipe disappears after use, but the recipe itself will be added to the known recipes section of your crafting interface.

[b]Item creation[/b]

Let’s take a closer look at the crafting process.

To open the crafting interface, make sure you’ve learned a profession from a matching instructor and press К or click an icon in the bottom menu.

Alternatively, you may approach a crafting station for your profession and press “Use”.

In craft interface window you may see all of the recipes you have already learned, the item you are about to create, equipment the materials you’re going to need, the amount of gold you are going to spend on crafting the item (or several items), the number of items you wish to create. 

Here you go, we wish you lucky craft! 

[h1]Unique item properties[/h1]

The battles in the world of Ericuria are about to become even more exciting! From now on all equipment in the world of Sphere comes with special properties. Now you’ll be able to become a proud owner of truly unique and wondrous things that nobody else has. 

When an item appears in the world, there is a small chance it comes with a number of special properties we call [b]affixes[/b]. 

Affixes can be very different: some may increase or decrease the item’s attributes, others may give it unusual properties or increase the number of gemstone sockets. 

You may get such an item by crafting it or by looting it from a threatening monster. Your best chance to receive such a special reward is to craft an item using a recipe obtained from a boss monster. Traditional crafting recipes yield items with affixes less often, and only the luckiest of players will get such treasures from enemies. 

You may get items with affixes by crafting traditional recipes above level 30 or by crafting recipes obtained from boss monsters above level 10. 

[h1]Enhancement system changes[/h1]

From now on upgrading an item without a protection crystal may result in critical failure. In this case the item loses its current enhancement level and may become damaged. Attempting to enhance an item without protection crystals may lead to one of the following results: 
[list]
[*]the attempt succeeds and the item enhancement level increases by 1. 
[*]the attempt fails and the item enhancement level decreases. 
[*]the attempt fails and the item becomes damaged. 
[*]the attempt fails, the item becomes damaged and its enhancement level decreases.
[*]the attempt fails but nothing else happens. 
[/list]
A damaged item remains functional. You may equip it and keep using it in the future, but you won’t be able to enhance or enchant it ever again. You will not be able to socket any gemstones, either. 

[b]Please use caution and remember to use protection crystals if you wish to continue upgrading your piece of equipment in the future.[/b]
